payload.summary: CME: build real year close (snapshot, dated amendments, shortfall note) as designed in cme-design-decisions.md section 9
payload.detail: closed_at on cme_years is enforced everywhere but nothing sets it; needs a cme_close_year function, snapshot and amendment tables, a trigger stopping closed_at being cleared outside that path, and closed-year guards on cme_requirements and cme_allocations. New migration, so owner-merged. The dashboard's year-end action was reworded on 2026-09-24 to point at the annual summary instead of a close step that does not exist.
